title: Love in defeatism
body:
I gave you my soul
i fell victim to your love
i gave you my heart
i flattened my ego

I lent you my life
and I gave away your interest
And if I left your space
Know that I loved you very much

But I get the complaint
of selfishness the abundant

How they changed so easily
our contacts on the phones?
How times are measured
as she asks to be left alone?

Emotional instability
Love in defeatism
Confusion and incoherence
From seisachtheia commitment

I insist on trying

* * *

Unanswered questions
backwards all steps
of our expectations victims
like a battle with the waves

I spoke frankly to you
to the front I kissed you
and goodbye I whispered to you
it hurt, but I didn't bend

But I get the complaint
before turning the block

How they got into trouble
your own feelings
to what extent on what scale
and were erasedfrom the board?

Emotional instability
Love in defeatism
Confusion and incoherence
From seisachtheia commitment

I keep trying

* * *

You were seen with a stranger
Infidelity Undiagnosed
of your silence the paradox
to mean an end inglorious

I'll pick up my pieces
i will also wipe my eyes
engraved my marks
in my heart now my leave

But I get the complaint
And it has left me speechless

How they dried up so quickly
of your heart the comforting
caresses, kissing, messages
of your love the samples

Emotional instability
Love in defeatism
Confusion and incoherence
From seisachtheia commitment

I stop trying
So many mistakes, so much ignorance
